title: Report: Nvidia to acquire AI model repository Hugging Face for $13 billion
summary: Nvidia is reportedly in advanced talks to acquire Hugging Face, a leading cloud repository for AI models, for approximately $12.9 billion. The deal aims to strengthen Nvidia's position in the AI ecosystem, particularly in open-weight models, and could help revive its cloud AI ambitions. Hugging Face, founded in 2016, serves as a key platform for developers and researchers to share, download, and fine-tune AI models. While not yet profitable, its strategic importance lies in being the de facto hub for open-weight AI models. The acquisition may also help Nvidia counter competition from companies like OpenAI and Anthropic, which are developing their own specialized hardware. Additionally, Hugging Face's expansion into robotics and physical AI aligns with Nvidia's existing strengths in these areas.
key_points: Nvidia is in talks to acquire Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, though the deal is not yet finalized.
Hugging Face is a cloud repository for AI models, often compared to GitHub for conventional software.
The acquisition would bolster Nvidia's influence in the open-weight AI model ecosystem, countering proprietary models from OpenAI and Anthropic.
Nvidia has previously invested in Hugging Face, alongside Google and Microsoft.
Hugging Face is not currently profitable but holds strategic value as the primary platform for open-weight AI models.
The deal could help Nvidia revive its cloud AI business, which previously struggled to gain traction.
Hugging Face's expansion into robotics and physical AI aligns with Nvidia's existing hardware and software strengths.
The acquisition may help Nvidia maintain its hardware dominance as competitors develop their own specialized AI chips.
